source.boundary: Synthetic wire example of the current native verification event; not live verification or deployment evidence. Native AppState leaves reporter organization/device/hardware fields null.

invariants: Only a live tenant-bound API key with explicit audit:write scope may ingest or read its own receipts.
Organization and producer ID derive from gateway-authenticated API-key authority, rechecked against the locked key record in PostgreSQL.
All events in a batch validate before persistence and commit atomically to the existing organization audit table.
Repeated identical event and verification IDs return the same receipt; changed payload or reused verification ID fails with HTTP 409.
Event and verification IDs are unique organization-wide; another producer or rotated API key cannot re-account or take ownership of either ID and receives HTTP 409.
Receipts report authenticated ingestion of a client-reported offline result, not cryptographic re-verification or physical-device attestation.
No credential, disclosed claims, raw biometric data or score, caller-provided authority, or free-form error fields are accepted.
